extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and grant applicants preparing NIH-style biosketches and application attachments (PIs, co-investigators, institutional grant admins)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and required content/format for Biographical Sketches and related personnel information in an NIH grant application (education/training, personal statement, positions, contributions, research support, attachments, and contact/profile fields).

rubrics_metrics.name: Required contact/profile fields (applicant/institution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields such as Street1, Street2, City*, County, State*, Province, Country*, Zip / Postal Code*, Phone Number*, Fax Number, E-Mail*, Credential (e.g., agency login), Project Role*, Other Project Role Category, Degree Type, Degree Year, File Name, Mime Type, Attach Biographical Sketch*, Attach Current & Pending Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. Provide complete contact information for each Senior/Key Person and attach the required files (biographical sketch and current & pending support) in the specified attachment fields with correct file name and MIME type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow specified biosketch format for each person
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2. Follow this format for each person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete each section (name, position title, eRA Commons user name, education/training, personal statement, positions and honors, contributions to science, and research support) for every listed person, using the prescribed order and headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limit — DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where indicated, the biographical sketch content for the person must not exceed four pages. Ensure adherence to the page limit for the specified form/version to avoid noncompliant submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limit — DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH ... DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some sections/instructions in the document repeat a five-page limit for Senior/key personnel. Follow the page limit specified on the particular form/version you are using (the document contains both 4- and 5-page instructions — use the form header/OMB-approved instruction applicable to your submission).

rubrics_metrics.name: Name, position title, and eRA Commons user name
rubrics_metrics.description: Include NAME, POSITION TITLE, and eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the exact position title used on the application and the eRA Commons username (or other credential) so personnel are unambiguously identified in agency systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table and content
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) — list Institution and Location, Degree (if applicable), MM/YY (completion date), and Field of Study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start with the earliest (baccalaureate) degree and proceed chronologically through advanced degrees and postdoctoral/residency training. Use the table format showing institution/location, degree, completion date (MM/YY), and field of study.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement — a narrative summarizing the individual's background, relevant experience, prior accomplishments, and qualifications to conduct and direct the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the person's prior work and expertise make them uniquely qualified for the project. Include descriptions of relevant prior positions/projects, key accomplishments, and specific contributions related to the current application.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors — list positions held (with dates) and notable honors/awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological listing of professional positions and relevant honors or awards that demonstrate experience and qualifications. Include dates and institutional affiliations for each position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards/Credentials section
rubrics_metrics.description: List awards and credentials (e.g., scholarships, distinguished titles, travel scholarships) with years and awarding bodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include relevant recognitions that support the applicant’s qualifications; use clear year ranges and award titles as examples in the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contributions to Science — narrative descriptions of the applicant's major scientific contributions, typically organized as numbered items with supporting citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize major research contributions, their significance, and provide selected representative publications (with citations, PMCID/PMID when available). Optionally provide a link to a complete list of published work (e.g., MyBibliography URL). Use numbered subsections and include brief explanatory text plus key references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include representative publications and identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: When listing publications under Contributions to Science, include citations and available identifiers (e.g., PMCID, PMID).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite specific papers that support the described contributions. Where available, include PMCID/PMID to facilitate verification and compliance with public access policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (Current and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — provide current and pending (or completed) research support entries including grant number, project title, PI name, project dates, funding source (e.g., NIH/NIAID), project goals, and the individual's role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For current support, list active grants with project period and describe the goal of the project and the individual's role (e.g., Role: PI). For completed support, include grant numbers, dates, project titles, and role. Indicate percent effort where appropriate (e.g., 'Role: Co-PI (Liu, PD/PI), 5% effort'). Attach Current & Pending Support documents as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments required for biosketch and current & pending support
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Biographical Sketch* and Attach Current & Pending Support: files (with file names and MIME types) for each individual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the specified PDF attachments (biographical sketch and current & pending support) in the application system in the required fields. Ensure files are correctly named and in accepted formats (e.g., application/pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use approved form/version (OMB info)
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB No. and approval date appear on the form (e.g., OMB No. 0925-0001 and 0925-0002 (Rev. 10/15) Approved Through 10/31/2018).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the currently approved form/version indicated by the OMB/control number and revision date. Follow the instructions and page limits associated with that approved form.
